recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Follow up in HL7/api-incubator-ig or the API Incubator publication process so the external page containing the PATCH/GraphQL trade-off guidance is available at a stable URL, then update the core handoff URL only after that target is published.
issue_request: FHIR-38923 was a Published FHIR-core change request for the Operations for Large Resources page, raised against Group and List for R5. The Persuasive with Modification resolution asked to explain overlap, differences, and trade-offs between the large-resource operations and PATCH while avoiding any assertion that PATCH requires XML or JSON source resources.
initial_application: Commit 9510c3ae69f5eb4e2d14fbccba5bb5cfd2312fc0 applied the issue in core by replacing the R5 ballot note on source/operations-for-large-resources.html with introductory operation guidance and explicit PATCH/GraphQL trade-off text. The R5 published page includes that paragraph and does not assert an XML/JSON precondition for PATCH.
additional_context: R6 source history later changed the current core page into an informative handoff to the API Incubator. Commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd removed the local operation details, including the FHIR-38923 paragraph, and current source/operations-for-large-resources.html now only points to the API Incubator. The external HL7/api-incubator-ig source contains the same PATCH/GraphQL trade-off paragraph, while live build.fhir.org API Incubator page probes currently return 404. Related FHIR-39102 is already represented on the combined branch by an external-repo audit for the same move of operation-definition details out of core.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. Re-adding the PATCH paragraph to the current core handoff page would duplicate content that now belongs with the detailed API Incubator operation page and would partially undo the later R6 decision to stop hosting those draft operation details in core.

related_jiras.note: Same Operations for Large Resources page; already represented on the combined branch by an external-repo audit for the R6 move of operation-definition details out of core.
